summary.zh: 做安全审查、补漏洞依赖与合规检查
summary.en: Security reviews, CVE patching and audit readiness

description.zh: 面向应用侧的安全运维：代码安全审查、漏洞依赖升级、密钥与认证加固，以及 SOC 2、PCI-DSS、HIPAA、GDPR 合规自检。适合上线前自查、被扫出 CVE 需要处置或准备审计材料时使用。
description.en: Handles application security operations: code reviews, CVE remediation, secrets and auth hardening, plus SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA and GDPR checks. Use it before launch, after a dependency alert, or ahead of an audit.
